ruflo.release_body:
## Fix

- **statusline: stop pinning intelligence to a hardcoded 0%** ([#3092](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/pull/3092), closes [#3091](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/issues/3091))

  `intelligencePct` had exactly one assignment in the whole statusline helper, inside the local-CLI fallback path. Every other read used it as-is, and the local-overlay repair pass — which already covers ADRs, AgentDB, tests, hooks, integration, and security — never touched `system`. So any CLI failure (a source-only plugin-marketplace checkout with no install step, or an `npx` fetch dying in a workspace root with no `version` field — both reachable under ordinary conditions) silently pinned the brain segment to a literal `0%` beside sibling segments that were still rendering live data, with nothing to tell them apart.

  `getLocalIntelligence()` now joins the local-overlay set: it derives the percentage from `.claude-flow/neural/patterns.json` (project, then home) whenever the CLI didn't already report a positive value, with the pattern-count parse cached on the store's mtime+size so a large store (14.5 MB / 1,277 patterns measured) doesn't get re-parsed on every prompt render. Unknown now renders as `—` instead of `0%`, so a genuinely-absent measurement is no longer indistinguishable from a real zero.

  Applied identically to both committed copies of the helper (`.claude/helpers/statusline.cjs` and `v3/@claude-flow/cli/.claude/helpers/statusline.cjs`).

🤖 Generated with [claude-flow](https://github.com/ruvnet/claude-flow)

orca.commit_message:
perf(git): only schedule the upstream-ref poll for the repo that has one (#16443)

* perf(git): only schedule the upstream-ref poll for the repo that has one

A single global binding means at most one worktree holds a selected upstream
ref at a time, so every other repo's 2s poll woke only to stat an empty set.
Rebinding is synchronous and in-process, so reacting to it detects a newly
selected ref exactly as fast as polling did — the wake-ups were pure waste.

Measured at 100 repos with no selected ref: 0.811 -> 0.320 CPU-ms/s idle.

* fix(git-watch): re-read ref selection after building the poller

A rebind can flip back while the poller is being constructed. The concurrent
unbind sees statusRefPolling still null and correctly does nothing, so without
re-reading selection the in-flight build adopts a poller for a repo that no
longer holds a ref — reinstating the idle wake-ups this change removes.

* fix(git-watch): fence concurrent ref-poller starts with a generation token

Startup and each rebind could be mid-build at once, and the startup path
adopted its poller unconditionally. A rebind that won the slot first was then
overwritten without being unsubscribed, stranding that poller's timer and
visibility listener for the process lifetime. The generation names which
attempt still owns the slot so every loser tears down what it built.

Adds a regression test driving the real binding path; it fails if the poller
is dropped without unsubscribing.

Reported by CodeRabbit on #16443.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.6.10

Released: 2026-08-18

## English

### Highlights

- Managed Claude agents now refresh an existing Agent-private macOS Keychain
  credential when an external Claude OAuth re-login changes the inherited
  source authentication (Issue #319).

### Fixes and reliability

- A stopped managed restart compares the new source payload with the prior
  CCB-owned `.credentials.json` projection and updates only the matching
  Agent-derived Keychain service when the source changed.
- When the inherited source is unchanged, Claude's own refresh in the private
  service is preserved. External Claude Keychain services remain read-only.
- Symlinked CCB credential projections and private Keychain inspection errors
  fail closed. Deterministic regression coverage includes source re-login,
  private refresh preservation, symlink rejection, and inspection failure.

### Upgrade notes

- Restart existing managed Claude agents after upgrading to `v8.6.10`.
- No project, conversation, pairing, or configuration migration is required.

### Known limitations

- Real macOS Keychain qualification remains a platform-owner gate; this Linux
  build was verified with deterministic Keychain fakes and the full available
  regression suite.

## 中文

### 版本亮点

- 外部 Claude OAuth 重新登录后，受管 Claude Agent 会在源认证发生变化时
  刷新已有的 Agent 私有 macOS Keychain 凭据（Issue #319）。

### 修复与稳定性

- 受管重启会将新的源 payload 与上一轮 CCB-owned `.credentials.json` 投影
  比较；只有源发生变化时，才更新对应的 Agent 派生 Keychain service。
- 继承源未变化时，保留 Claude 在私有 service 中自行刷新的凭据。外部 Claude
  Keychain service 始终保持只读。
- CCB 凭据投影是 symlink，或私有 Keychain 检查出错时，会 fail closed。回归
  测试覆盖源重登录、私有刷新保留、symlink 拒绝和检查失败场景。

### 升级说明

- 升级到 `v8.6.10` 后，请重启现有受管 Claude Agent。
- 无需迁移项目、对话、配对或配置。

### 已知限制

- 真实 macOS Keychain 验证仍需平台维护者门禁；本次 Linux 构建已通过确定性
  Keychain fake 和当前完整回归测试。

trellis.commit_message:
fix(channel): continue seq after a torn events.jsonl tail (#564)

* fix(channel): continue seq after a torn events.jsonl tail

CLI supervisor/spawn/kill appended via a local readLastSeq that returned 0
when the last JSONL line was unparseable. A SIGKILL/ENOSPC torn tail then
reset seq to 1 and glued the next record onto the incomplete line.

Route appendEvent/readLastSeq through core, truncate a missing-newline tail
to the last complete line, then reconcileSeq so allocation continues from
the last parseable record.

Closes #527

* test(channel): await fire-and-forget appends before wait-warning teardown

CLI wait tests woke as soon as the JSONL record appeared, then afterEach
deleted the temp dir while core was still renaming .seq. On Linux CI that
surfaced as unhandled ENOENT even though every assertion passed.

---------

# v0.6.15

> 2026-08-14

新增 DeepSeek Harness，成为第 22 个支持的平台。

## 新增平台

### DeepSeek Harness

```bash theme={null}
trellis init --dsh
```

共享的工作流和内置 skill 写入 `.agents/skills/`，用户可调用的入口 skill
（`trellis-start`、`trellis-continue`、`trellis-finish-work`）写入
`.dsh/skills/`，也就是 dsh 自己优先级最高的项目 skill 目录。操作指南放在
`.dsh/DSH.md`。

dsh 会自动发现这两个 skill 目录，并通过它的 skill-loader 工具按名字加载，
不需要手动注册。默认的 web 和 headless 配置没有 session-start hook，所以
`trellis-start` 是你手动调用的 skill，不会自动触发。

dsh 没有项目级的 sub-agent 定义面，因此 research、implement、check 三个阶段
都在主会话里直接执行，不会派给 sub-agent。支持 sub-agent 派发的平台数仍然
是 18 个。

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

不需要 `--migrate`。
